description: This file contains an implementation of the XxHash32 non-cryptographic hash algorithm, including class definition, methods for hashing data, and internal state management.

classes.name: XxHash32
classes.description: Provides an implementation of the XxHash32 hashing algorithm, supporting hash computation with optional seed, appending data, and retrieving hash value.

methods.name: Reset
methods.description: Resets the hash computation to the initial state.

methods.name: Append
methods.description: Appends data to the hash computation, processing in stripes.

methods.name: GetCurrentHashCore
methods.description: Computes the current hash value without modifying the internal state.

methods.name: Hash
methods.description: Computes the hash of provided data, with overloads for seed and array input.

methods.name: TryHash
methods.description: Attempts to compute the hash into a provided buffer, indicating success or failure.
